components.scope: Paula audio tangent and the FPU 68881/68882 (T54): integer SoftFloat (softfloat.cpp), its decimal extension (softfloat_decimal.cpp), the FPSP transcendental functions (softfloat_fpsp.cpp) and the FPU front ends fpp.cpp and fpp_softfloat.cpp; fpp_native.cpp (host FPU, long double) is excluded
components.declared_license: Mixed SoftFloat-2a, BSD and GPL-2.0-or-later portions as identified in retained source notices; the decimal and FPSP extensions are extensions to SoftFloat Release 2a (FPSP attributed to Andreas Grabher for Previous, NeXT Computer Emulator); fpp.cpp (Herman ten Brugge 1996, Peter Keunecke 2005, Toni Wilen) and fpp_softfloat.cpp (Andreas Grabher and Toni Wilen) are WinUAE sources under GPL-2.0-or-later like the rest of the engine
components.handling: Retain all mixed notices and attribution for these nine files; do not relabel as BSD-only. Patches 0021 and 0143 (case-exact include of SOFTFLOAT-MACROS.H) and 0140-0142, 0144 and 0145 identify PUAE6 derivative changes. The FPSP source and tables identify an extension to SoftFloat2a/FPSP; the decimal file says it is an extension to SoftFloat 2a without further terms, so it is kept with the SoftFloat-2a notice. Release packaging must reproduce the retained notices. The FPU is computed only by these files, never by fpp_native.cpp, the host FPU or long double (determinism, T54).
components.build_eligibility: selected: softfloat.cpp, softfloat_fpsp.cpp, softfloat_decimal.cpp, fpp.cpp and fpp_softfloat.cpp, four headers; fpp_native.cpp not selected
